properties.name: Ammunition
properties.description: Use to make ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire. Drawing ammo is part of attack.

properties.name: Finesse
properties.description: When making an attack, use your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier for attack and damage rolls.

properties.name: Heavy
properties.description: Small creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls with heavy weapons.

properties.name: Light
properties.description: Ideal for use in two-weapon fighting.

properties.name: Loading
properties.description: Because of the time required to load, you can fire only one piece of ammunition from it when you use an action, bonus action, or reaction.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Has normal range and long range. Attacks beyond normal range have disadvantage; cannot attack beyond long range.

properties.name: Reach
properties.description: Adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for opportunity attacks.

properties.name: Special
properties.description: A weapon with the special property has unusual rules governing its use, detailed in weapon description.

properties.name: Thrown
properties.description: Can throw weapon to make ranged attack. Use same ability modifier for attack and damage as melee attack.

properties.name: Two-Handed
properties.description: Requires two hands when you attack with it.

properties.name: Versatile
properties.description: Can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property—the damage when used two-handed.
